new.name: AskMed
new.description: AskMed answers medical questions with cited sources: you ask about a condition, drug, interaction or guideline and get a clear answer that links to the journal articles, clinical guidelines and drug labels it relies on, plus a research mode for deeper literature work. It is built for physicians, nurses, pharmacists and medical students, on the web and iOS.

new.name: contracts.io
new.description: contracts.io drafts a contract from one sentence: its assistant Lex writes a plain-English agreement such as a statement of work for England and Wales, you send a single link, and the other side reads, counters clause by clause with tracked redlines and e-signs without an account or fee. Lex also explains contracts you have been sent. The free plan covers three active contracts; Plus (£15/month) adds unlimited contracts and templates.

new.name: AI Rap Video.cc
new.description: AI Rap Video.cc turns one or two portrait photos into a short AI rap performance with vocals and music, set in a studio, street or party scene, or recasts a reference clip with your faces in Video Remix. You choose the video model (Seedance, Wan or Kling) and resolution, and credits are refunded when a run is blocked; one-time credit packs start at $9.99.

new.name: Zambo
new.description: Zambo is a hosted MCP server you add to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code or Grok with one URL, no key and no signup: it gives your AI tools to check sites, protect bots and find customers, keeps the job's notes so another chat or another AI can pick it up, and issues a verifiable receipt link for every step that you can send a client. Every tool is free once a day; a $0.99 day pass or $29 30-day pass unlocks unlimited use.

new.name: EverygenAI Photo to Sketch
new.description: EverygenAI Photo to Sketch turns a single portrait or object photo into a clean pencil drawing with defined contours and natural graphite shading, from light line art to a fully shaded study. You upload a PNG, JPG or WebP up to 10 MB, optionally describe the style, pick a model and generate; the page also explains how to choose sources with clear edges and simple backgrounds for better sketches. Generations use credits.

new.name: EveryGen AI
new.description: EveryGen AI is a web video studio that puts models such as Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0 Turbo, Veo 3.1, MiniMax and Grok Imagine behind one prompt box for text-to-video and image-to-video, plus trend templates for viral dances and memes. Its Marketing Studio turns a product photo into a UGC-style ad, unboxing, product-hero or before-and-after video with captions and lip-synced creators, and it includes a 4K image generator.

new.name: Prizm
new.description: Prizm tailors your CV and cover letter to each job: you add your CV once as Word, PDF or a photo, paste a job link or text, and it first gives an honest assessment of your chances with real strengths and gaps, then rewrites both documents for that role in your own Word layout or one of five templates. You review every change and nothing is invented; the first check is free with no card.

new.name: Pumli
new.description: Pumli is a private AI companion for iPhone and iPad that runs local language models on the device, up to 35B parameters on compatible hardware, so chats and dictation work offline and stay on the phone. When you choose, it connects to Notion, GitHub, Exa, Context7, Calendar, Messages, Reminders and Health, drafts email, researches with sources and makes AI images and video through online providers, with memories you can review and edit.

stars.name: REA
stars.description: MCP server and CLI that lets coding agents reverse engineer native binaries, Electron and JavaScript apps, .NET assemblies and live websites, using Ghidra, Hopper or IDA under the hood.

stars.name: OpenClaw
stars.description: OpenClaw is an MIT-licensed personal AI assistant that runs on your own computer and answers in the chat apps you already use, including Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram and WhatsApp, with native apps for macOS, iOS, Android, Windows and Linux. State, memory and credentials stay on your hardware, models and harnesses such as Claude, Codex or local models are swappable plugins, and one gateway can run a personal or shared multiplayer assistant. It is stewarded by the non-profit OpenClaw Foundation with no paid tier or hosted service.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); you pay only for the model providers you connect.

stars.name: ECC
stars.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond

stars.name: DeepSeek Harness
stars.description: DeepSeek's open-source agent harness with a local web UI, built so that every tool, model and scheduled task is a swappable plugin; still a developer preview.

stars.name: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
stars.description: Hermes Agent is Nous Research's MIT-licensed, self-improving agent with a built-in learning loop: it writes skills from completed tasks, refines them in use, keeps agent-curated memory and searches its own past conversations. It runs on anything from a $5 VPS to serverless infrastructure, offers a full terminal UI, and one gateway serves Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal and the CLI, with any model via Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI or your own endpoint.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); model usage billed by your chosen provider.

stars.name: opencode
stars.description: OpenCode is an MIT-licensed open-source AI coding agent for the terminal, with a beta desktop app, that works with many model providers instead of locking you to one. Install it with a one-line script, npm, Homebrew, pacman, mise or Nix, then let it read your repository, edit files and run commands from a keyboard-driven TUI.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); bring your own model provider.

stars.name: n8n
stars.description: Workflow automation with AI agent nodes; self-host or cloud.

stars.name: Firecrawl
stars.description: Firecrawl is an AGPL-3.0 web data API for AI agents, open source and available as a hosted service: Search returns full page content for web results, Scrape turns any URL into clean Markdown, HTML, screenshots or structured JSON, Crawl and Map cover whole sites, Interact clicks, scrolls and types before extracting, and Parse converts PDFs and DOCX files. It handles proxies, rate limits and JavaScript-heavy pages for you, and connects to any agent or MCP client with a single command.
